the SLE patients have a V(H) 5 gene family bias in their repertoire, and that the anti-ds DNA autoantibody response in SLE is dominated by a V(H)3 gene family bias, and is restricted to a subset of V(lambda) light chains.

the heavy chain repertoire is the main driver of autoantibody development in SLE, and the heavy chain genes are inherited.
the autoantibodies of SLE can be generated by somatic hypermutation and affinity maturation processes that are not unique to SLE.
